fields.label: Type
fields.description: Optional media to display above the question.

semantics.label: Task description
semantics.default: Identify the items asked for below. Type one answer and press Enter to add it to your list.

semantics.label: Supporting text
semantics.description: Optional text shown below the task, e.g. the paragraph learners should search.

semantics.label: Acceptable answers
semantics.description: One answer per line. Separate alternative spellings or synonyms with |, e.g. bike | bicycle. Each line can only be matched once.

semantics.label: Maximum number of items
semantics.description: The most items a learner can add to the list. Leave empty to use the number of acceptable answers.

semantics.label: Correct items needed for full score
semantics.description: This is also the maximum score. Leave empty to use the maximum number of items. Use a lower number for tasks like "name at least two".

semantics.label: Points deducted per incorrect item
semantics.description: 0 means no penalty. The score never goes below 0.

fields.label: Define custom feedback for any score range
fields.description: Click the "Add range" button to add as many ranges as you need. Example: 0-20% Bad score, 21-91% Average Score, 91-100% Great Score!

fields.label: Accept minor spelling errors
fields.description: Answers with small typos (e.g. one wrong letter) are accepted.

fields.label: Ignore leading articles
fields.description: Ignore words such as "a", "an" and "the" at the start of an answer. The word list can be changed in the text overrides.

semantics.label: Behavioural settings
semantics.description: These options will let you control how the task behaves.

fields.label: Instant feedback
fields.description: Mark each item as correct or incorrect as soon as it is added.

fields.label: Enable "Retry"
fields.description: Removes all items so the learner starts over.

fields.label: Enable "Retry incorrect"
fields.description: Removes the incorrect items and keeps the correct ones.

fields.label: Require a full list before checking
Prevent copying the task text
fields.description: Learners can't select, copy or right-click the task description and supporting text, so they have to type their answers.

fields.label: Prevent pasting into the answer field
fields.description: Blocks pasting with keyboard shortcuts, the right-click menu, and drag and drop.

fields.label: Placeholder for the answer field
fields.default: Type an answer and press Enter

fields.label: Message when the answer is empty
Message when the answer is already in the list
fields.default: That answer is already in your list.

fields.label: Placeholder when the list is full
fields.default: Your list is full. Remove an item to add another.

fields.label: Message when pasting is blocked
fields.default: Pasting is turned off. Type your answer instead.

fields.label: Message when checking an empty list
fields.default: Add at least one item before checking.

fields.label: Message when the list must be full before checking
Textual representation of the score bar for those using a screen reader
Assistive technology label for "Check" button
fields.default: Check the answers. The responses will be marked as correct or incorrect.

fields.label: Assistive technology label for "Show solution" button
fields.default: Show the solution. The task will be marked with its correct solution.

fields.label: Assistive technology label for "Retry" button
fields.default: Retry the task. All answers are removed.

fields.label: Assistive technology label for "Retry incorrect" button
fields.default: Retry the incorrect answers. Incorrect answers are removed; correct answers are kept.
